criteria.text: User Action: Opens the “House” tab. Expected System Behavior: The House page opens with the household name, member count, and a roster of housemates. Each row shows an avatar with initials and the housemate’s name. The user is labeled “You,” and the household manager has a “Household manager” chip.
User Action: Selects a housemate. Expected System Behavior: That housemate’s profile opens (see SCRUM-72 and SCRUM-63).
criteria.note: Placeholder until SCRUM-72 and SCRUM-63 are built: a housemate opens a stand-in profile screen (README Conflicts row 30).

criteria.text: The household manager card shows the current household manager. With no manager, it shows “No Household Manager assigned” and a “Become household manager” button (see SCRUM-62).
criteria.note: Until SCRUM-62 is built there is no household manager: the card shows “No Household Manager assigned” without the “Become household manager” button. Its test is written but skipped until then, so this AC stays open (README Conflicts row 30).

criteria.text: User Action: Clicks “Invite housemates.” Expected System Behavior: The household invite code and link appear with “Copy” and “Share” buttons.
criteria.note: Team decision (Anthony, 2026-11-15): one share icon at the top right of the invite code opens the phone’s share sheet with the /join/CODE link; no Copy button. Jira not updated yet (README Conflicts row 31).

criteria.text: User Action: Clicks “Copy.” Expected System Behavior: The invite link is copied. Message: “Invite link copied.”
criteria.note: Team decision (Anthony, 2026-11-15): there is no Copy button. Where the browser has no share sheet, the share icon copies the link and shows “Invite link copied.” (README Conflicts row 31).

criteria.text: Leaving a household happens from the profile page (see SCRUM-75).
Error Condition: The House page fails to load. Message: “We couldn’t load your household. Please try again.” with a “Retry” button.
Error Condition: The invite link can’t be created. Message: “Couldn’t create an invite link. Please try again.”
criteria.note: The link is built from the household’s invite code, so it exists whenever the page loads; a failed load is AC7. Nothing triggers this message yet (README Conflicts row 31).
